Class GameController

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Per-game controller that owns the ControllerState state machine.

All client requests for a single game are routed here by ServerController. Each call to handleClientRequest(ClientRequest, VirtualClient) dispatches the request to the current state via the visitor pattern, then drives automatic state transitions until a manual (waiting) state is reached.

  • Method Details

    • handleClientRequest

      public void handleClientRequest(ClientRequest req, VirtualClient virtualClient) throws ServerException
      Dispatches req to the current state and drives automatic state transitions until a manual (waiting) state is reached.

      Synchronized to serialise concurrent requests for the same game.

      Parameters:
      req - the request to handle
      virtualClient - the client who sent the request
      Throws:
      ServerException - if the current state rejects the request, host exit or a state-transition loop is detected

    • getLobbyPlayers

      public List<String> getLobbyPlayers()
      Returns the display names of all players currently in the game, or an empty list if no state has been set yet. Used by ServerController to build the per-game player map included in HomeUpdate.
      Returns:
      immutable list of player names; never null

    • getCapacity

      public int getCapacity()
      Returns the maximum number of players allowed in the game, or 0 if no state has been set yet. Used by ServerController to build the per-game capacity map included in HomeUpdate.
      Returns:
      player capacity of the underlying game, or 0 if unset
